doc: Spec 16 (materials) views of §1.3, rendered in spec 17's LookDev (AgX Base Contrast, no grade) by materials.swatch() (python scripts/eval/lookdev.py --swatch IDS). V1 is the flat swatch LookDev.Swatch beside Cal.Card18, V2 the macro at 0.09 mm/px, V3 the wear block (Lib.Test.WearBlock is not built: it needs the weathering groups of §4.2-4.4). V7 (added 2026-10-10) puts the recipe on Lib.Test.Ball and on Lib.Test.Toe with Lib.Test.Nail (skin and nails) or on Lib.Test.Fold (fabrics): the material-ball view a flat swatch cannot give for translucent skin and nails. V4 (hero patches), V5 (camouflage) and V6 (bake round trip) wait for spec 17's light solve, MG.Camo.Blotch4 and the bakes.

presets.label: swatch
presets.note: 0.27 mm/px; the key 45 degrees off the camera axis so no specular peak reaches it

presets.label: macro
presets.note: 0.09 mm/px: the weave, knit or grain period is measured here (spec 16 M4)

presets.label: wear
presets.note: needs Lib.Test.WearBlock and MG.Weather.Dust, MG.Mask.EdgeBevel and MG.Weather.Chips (not built)

presets.label: balls
presets.note: Lib.Test.Ball (60 mm), Lib.Test.Toe (22 mm) with Lib.Test.Nail, or Lib.Test.Fold, beside the card; 28 degrees down
